notes: iOS thread screens (L4): ThreadScreen(client:sessionId:targetSeq:) is the one entry for every thread type and a subagent's detail: a header with the type label tinted, the model and the running elapsed; two segments per board type on an interactive pager (Board/Chat, Plan/Chat, Fleet/Log, Sources/Chat), remembered per thread, with a dot on the inactive segment for a new needs-you card, defaults by type and phase (a question forces a planning thread's Chat, a report completing on screen moves to Sources); the 28 pt working strip and the composer bar reserved for L5; the tab bar hidden under the dock. Chat: the newest 75 rows and one page back at the top, pinned to the bottom with a Jump-to-latest pill, a bordered user field with image thumbnails, the markdown page (inline code one step down in mono, code blocks sideways-scrolling with Copy), thinking folded with the dim half, one-line tool chips (glyph, verb, mono target, tabular duration; spinner while running, destructive when failed) opening in place with the doc's spring and an omitted body fetched behind a shimmer, edit rows with +n −m into a unified diff screen, approval and question cards with their decided state, quiet compaction/error/system lines, plan-tool calls as quiet lines, subagent rows that push the child. Implementation board: goal, passes in the desktop's colours, todos with the running row open and its trace by groupByTodo, changes by todo with a numeric count, needs-you cards inline, the closing report, the fleet. Plan page over file.read, the fleet with 150 ms cross-fading activity lines and the agent detail on the same screen, the sources board with the report pin, angles, queries and sources. Client package: ThreadFold (fold.ts and todos.ts: round, todo and pass stamps, BoardState), Board (rounds.ts), ResearchBoard, Fleet, PlanDoc, a per-row MarkdownCache parsed off the main actor; threads fold incrementally on tail appends, streaming previews replace in place, opens are reference-counted; 60 tests ported from fold, rounds, researchBoard, agents and planDoc. Contract: file.read joins the subset. Test server: one thread per type, a 2,000-row chat, /asset/file served; scripts/ios-sim-proof.sh gains the threads, scroll and box sets beside the shell walk, the host-gone shot last.
